title: Read the dielectric loss tangent (Df) of each layer
summary: Shows how to iterate the dielectric layers of a board's master layer stack and read each layer's material, dielectric constant and loss tangent through the typed IPCB_DielectricLayer properties.
phrasings: get Dk and Df of the layer stack
list dielectric layers and their materials
read the loss tangent of a PCB core
iterate layers of a given class in the stackup

commands.name: GetDfValue
